newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Aug 30.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Aug 30.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers rose on perceptions of tight 380 cst supplies and crude amid a confused market. "There are very mixed signals, offers are very wide-ranged," a trader said. Offers were heard between $107.50-$111, with 180 cst talked $4 higher. On Thursday, 380 cst was at $106-$108 with 180 cst at $110-$114. MDO and gas oil rose on cargo's strength with offers at $190-$198 and $205-$206 respectively, up from $188-$194 and $203-$207. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703086)
